open_findings.description: logger.warn('Validation failed', { errors: error.details }) — Joi error.details includes context.value carrying the rejected request body. On auth endpoints (/login, /register, /change-password, /reset-password) this leaks plaintext passwords/emails to log storage.
open_findings.fix: Map error.details to { message, path, type } only — strip context.value before logging
